title: B3 real-SWAP prescribed-head corrector admissibility topology near the accepted fixed point
execution_contract: Each head is evaluated in a fresh child process with a newly initialized F-GC44 B3 real-SWAP origin.
No MODFLOW solve is used; only the unchanged prescribed-head SWAP corrector is evaluated.
Record raw participant status and q_swap when status=0.
No head is moved or retried after observing status.
gates: The CURRENT_PLUS_U accepted head (0 pm offset) is admissible and reproduces its recorded corrector flux within 1e-18 m/s.
The exact MAP05 INTERCEPT_ONLY failed head reproduces participant status 6.
At least one grid point is admissible and at least one grid point is inadmissible.
Repeated critical offsets reproduce the same admissibility status.
characterization_only: number and ordering of valid/invalid intervals
distance from current accepted head to nearest invalid sample
whether admissibility appears monotone over the fixed grid
interpretation_rules: This is a post-observation numerical-domain diagnostic, not blind validation.
A nonmonotone validity pattern is evidence about the corrector solve envelope, not about discontinuous physical hydrology.
Do not infer a physical head tolerance from the grid spacing.
Do not enlarge or shrink the corrector envelope in production from this diagnostic alone.
forbidden: no adaptive bisection after seeing the grid
do not use MAP06 to retroactively pass MAP05
